# TokenLedger — AI & LLM API FinOps Studio

> Browser-private AI & LLM API cost calculator, multi-turn agent burn simulator, SaaS gross margin calculator, Vector DB comparator, AI coding seat vs BYOK planner, and public JSON pricing feed covering 36 flagship models across 20 interactive workspaces.

## Core Interactive Tools
- [36-Model LLM API Cost Estimator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/): Live prompt token counter, prompt caching, 50% batch discounts, model cascade savings, CSV/JSON/PDF export.
- [AI Agent Loop Burn Calculator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/agent-budget.html): Quadratic O(N²) turn-by-turn token snowballing vs. caching and sliding-window summarization.
- [MCP & Tool Schema Bloat Auditor](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/mcp-schema-auditor.html): Upfront MCP server schema token tax, lazy tool deferral savings, and raw JSON tool ranker.
- [AI SaaS Gross Margin Simulator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/saas-margin.html): Per-seat LLM COGS, payment fees, gross margin %, and power-user break-even caps.
- [RAG & Vector DB TCO Planner](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/rag-calculator.html): Embedding ingestion, HNSW RAM footprint, re-index churn, and Top-K synthesis spend.
- [Vector Database Cloud Cost Comparator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/vector-db-cost-calculator.html): Pinecone Serverless vs Qdrant Cloud vs pgvector vs Weaviate vs Turbopuffer across FP32/INT8/Binary quantization.
- [AI Coding Assistant Seat vs. BYOK API Calculator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/ai-coding-seat-vs-api.html): Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf & Claude Max developer seat break-even vs cached BYOK token spend.
- [Self-Hosted GPU vs Cloud API Break-Even Calculator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/self-host-vs-api.html): H100/A100/L40S/4090 vLLM hourly + DevOps break-even vs cloud LLM APIs.
- [Voice, Vision & Multimodal Cost Studio](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/multimodal-budget.html): PDF/image vision tokens, OpenAI Realtime vs Gemini Live voice, and image generation.
- [AI Startup Burn & Runway Planner](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/ai-runway.html): 24-month cash trajectory, MRR-scaled LLM burn, and Default-Alive month calculator.
- [Prompt A/B Compression Cost Diff & CI Guard](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/prompt-diff.html): Before/after prompt token savings across 6 flagship models + GitHub Action YAML generator.
- [Fine-Tuning vs. RAG vs. Prompt Caching 12-Month TCO](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/fine-tune-vs-rag.html): Compare LoRA retrains, vector DB synthesis, and long-context prompt caching with ADR export.
- [LLM Rate-Limit (RPM/TPM/Concurrency) Capacity Planner](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/llm-rate-limit-planner.html): Peak TPM, Little's Law concurrency sizing, vendor tier guidance, and rate-limiter JSON policy export.
- [LLM GPU VRAM & KV-Cache Quantization Calculator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/gpu-vram-calculator.html): Exact weights + GQA KV-cache VRAM across FP16/FP8/Q4_K_M for Llama 70B, Qwen & DeepSeek-R1.
- [Enterprise LLM Savings Waterfall (Cache + Cascade + Batch)](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/batch-vs-realtime-router.html): Stacked FinOps savings waterfall & CFO executive memo export.
- [Speech-to-Text (STT) & TTS Audio API Cost Calculator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/audio-transcription-cost.html): Compare Whisper, Deepgram Nova-3, Groq, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs & Cartesia with VAD silence trimming.
- [AI Image & Video Generation Studio Budget Calculator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/image-video-gen-budget.html): Unit economics for FLUX, GPT-Image-1, Imagen 3, Veo, Runway Gen-4 & Sora with retry multipliers and draft cascades.
- [LLM Latency, TTFT & Streaming Speed Calculator](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/llm-latency-ttft-calculator.html): Benchmark TTFT, tok/s throughput, and SLA pass rates across Cerebras, Groq, Fireworks, Gemini, GPT-5 & Claude 4.5.
- [AI SaaS Pricing Tier & Credit-Pack Architect](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/ai-pricing-tier-designer.html): Generate margin-safe Free/Pro/Team/Enterprise credit allowances & Stripe billing JSON specs.
- [Context Window & JSON Minifier Inspector](https://tokenledger-8x7.pages.dev/tools/token-inspector.html): OpenAI/Claude/Gemini token estimates and one-click JSON tool schema minification.
